label: Elevated Jagati Platform & Carved Adhisthana
description: Massive granite and sandstone elevated terrace (jagati) featuring continuous horizontal friezes of war processions, royal retinues, elephants, and musicians celebrating Chandela majesty.

iconography.thematic_meaning: Cosmic foundation separating the sacred temple precinct from the mundane realm.

label: Sculptural Wall Register & Mithuna Facade
description: Intricately carved intermediate register adorned with over 800 life-sized statues of surasundaris (celestial nymphs), vyalas (mythical leonine beasts), and iconic mithuna couples celebrating non-dual divine union.

iconography.thematic_meaning: Celebration of kama (sensory delight) harmonized with dharma, artha, and moksha in Nagara metaphysical architecture.

label: Urushringa & Soaring Nagara Shikhara Spire
description: Monumental Nagara sikhara rising 31 meters, surrounded by 84 miniature replicated spires (urushringas) creating a rhythmically cascading mountain-peak silhouette resembling Mount Kailash.

iconography.thematic_meaning: Meru-Kailash mountain axis (axis mundi) directing spiritual energy vertically toward transcendence.
